newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bad weather causes French Bourse suspension.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather causes French Bourse suspension.

text.p: The French Bourse said trading had been suspended from 1440 GMT on Wednesday after a sudden storm caused problems with the price publication system.

A spokesman said that prices were no longer available at the same time to all participants, creating a false market. He said trading was suspended until further notice but might not resume on Wednesday. The market normally closes at 1500 GMT.
The was a sudden and brief thunderstorm in Paris in the afternoon with heavy rain.
The bourse's CAC-40 blue-chip index was last quoted at 2,682.87 points, up 18.69 points, or 0.7 percent. It came off its highs after Wall Street shares gave up their early gains and turned lower.
